@everyone

Hey everyone, quick server update:

We’re running into some server-side issues that are going to require extra maintenance time. The team is working through it now, but we’ll need additional downtime before things are stable again.

Current ETA is roughly 6-12 hours.

We know this is frustrating, especially during an active update window, and we appreciate everyone’s patience while we get this cleaned up properly. We’ll share another update as soon as we have more information.

Release 0.4.2 is now live! Enjoy guys!

0.4.2H Calido Underground Hotfix


NEW FEATURES:

-Team Deathmatch added to the Crowne Games
-New sales items added
-36 new quests added to Civic Works

FIXES:

-various fixes to inventory systems, stash and timings

-exploit prevention work

-various bug fixes

NOTES:

-You can store up to 500 items between your players stash and inventory, although the value is not capped on everything.

Exceeding 500 items stored across your avatar, clothing, packs, and stash, could lead to the loss of the ability to load into levels. Resulting in a inventory wipe needed from the main menu to restore access.

DO NOT EXCEED 500 ITEMS TOTAL.

@everyone

 A quick clarification about IGC (In Game Currency) Packs!

We've seen a few questions about the new IGC packs in the store, so we wanted to clear things up.

At the moment, IGC is primarily used to help accelerate furnishing and building out your apartments.

We've also had questions about wipes that can happen as part of new builds during development. If a wipe occurs, any IGC you've already spent will be restored to your account. That means you won't lose the value of your purchased IGC due to a development wipe.

We hope that helps put your mind at ease. If you have any other questions about IGC or how it works, feel free to ask. We're happy to help!
